name: std::unordered_multiset<Key,Hash,KeyEqual,Allocator>::begin(size_type), std::unordered_multiset<Key,Hash,KeyEqual,Allocator>::cbegin(size_type)
intro: Returns an iterator to the first element of the bucket with index n.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
n

 -

examples.title: Practical example
